metadata.title: Aozora Signal - Knowledge Demo
metadata.brief: 2000s Japanese galgame/anime OP instrumental, about one minute
metadata.revision_note: Final checklist polish: deduplicated the Pre fill, restored a quieter first-half build, and clarified Chorus piano accents.

piano.role: motif, answer phrases, and chorus broken-chord propulsion

intro.intent: State the motif, then turn into a harmonic answer.

verse.intent: Lower-register question/answer with space after each chord.

chorus.intent: High broken-chord propulsion; guitar owns the hook.

bass.role: directed chord-tone line coordinated with, not copied from, kick

intro.intent: Sparse roots plus fifths and approaches; enter gently.

verse.intent: Four purposeful attacks per bar with rests and chord-tone direction.

pre_chorus.intent: Ascending lines aim at the chorus dominant.

chorus.intent: Eighth-note drive using chord tones and next-chord approaches.

guitar.role: late verse muted comping, pre sustain, and chorus hook

verse.intent: Enter only in bars 5–8 with muted off-beat power shapes.

pre_chorus.intent: Sustain power shapes to contrast the muted verse.

chorus.intent: Own the singable hook and use sparse power-chord punctuation.

strings.role: delayed answers, inner movement, swell, and counter melody

intro.intent: Delayed high answer only; no block harmony.

verse.intent: Single inner voice with two small phrase answers.

pre_chorus.intent: Rising two-voice swell into a single ascending line.

chorus.intent: Independent quarter-note counter melody and occasional low anchor.

pad.role: quiet atmosphere and section width with a pre-chorus dropout

intro.intent: Wide, quiet glue under the motif.

verse.intent: One broad chord per bar below the foreground.

pre_chorus.intent: Support bars 1–3, then rest for the chorus impact.

chorus.intent: Return wider but stay subordinate to hook and rhythm.

drums.role: section-specific groove, energy development, and transitions

intro.intent: Sparse pulse grows into a small pickup fill.

verse.intent: Tight backbeat, alternating hat accents, and restrained kick variation.

pre_chorus.intent: Opening hats and denser kick/tom motion build expectation.

chorus.intent: Full groove with structural crashes and 8-bar fills.
